name: Invoice Desk 2: Approval
description: Sends the owner an Approve/Reject email for a document, waits up to 7 days, then updates the register and the supplier list.

parameters.content:
## Approval
Called by **Process Document** (not awaited) for anything over the limit, from a new supplier, in another currency, or failing a check.

The owner gets one email with what the document is, why it needs them, the lines and a link to the file, plus **Approve** / **Reject** buttons. The run waits up to 7 days.

The click updates the register. Approving a new supplier adds it to the supplier list; approving a confirmed bank change makes the new account the one on file. No click: the row stays as it is and the weekly summary lists it.
